messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: metering-proxy/token-counter mismatch (alert-id: MTR-9982). High error rate in token-aggregation service.

alice_sre: saw the pager. Investigating proxy layer between edge-ingest and token-counter. Initial spike ~ 2310456700.

ben_billing: customers reporting overage flags + billing spikes on the console. We got 3 inbound tickets in the last 10m. Priority: high.

carla_prodeng: @dan_oncall can you confirm if any recent deploy touched the proxy or metering config? I just checked deploy-log; no prod deploys in last 2 hours.

dan_oncall: I'm on it. Jumping into proxy logs now. `kubectl logs -n infra proxy-0 | grep token`

dan_oncall: quick snippet from proxy stderr:
```
2026-03-15T10:04:12Z ERROR request=abcd1234 missing-x-token-ctx
2026-03-15T10:04:12Z WARN request=abcd1234 downstream-count=1 upstream-count=2
2026-03-15T10:04:13Z INFO flush-window=512 active-conn=42
```

dan_oncall: looks like proxy is duplicating header forwarding for some keepalive connections; token-counter sees two partial chunks and double-counts tokens.

oncall_ml: that would explain token-count drift in aggregator. Are we seeing duplicate trace IDs?

evelyn_data: yes, we see same trace_id across two partial ingest events within <50ms. Metric: `token_counter.duplicates.per_min` spiked to 420 (baseline ~0-2).

alice_sre: mitigation? Can we add a short dedupe layer upstream or patch proxy to coalesce?

carla_prodeng: rolling a hotfix to proxy would be fastest. But can we temporarily enable billing-fallback that uses last-known-good counts to avoid immediate overcharges? Ben?

ben_billing: we have a safety mode: `billing.overage_protect=true` toggles out-of-band overage flags for 30m. I can flip it but need approval from SRE lead.

alice_sre: approve. Flip it. We need to buy time for a proper fix and reconciliation.

ben_billing: flipping flag now. `PUT /admin/flags/billing.overage_protect true` -> 202 Accepted. :white_check_mark:

frank_support: pinging customers who already opened tickets with note: "We're investigating anomalous billing signals; protective measures enabled; no charges will be finalized until we reconcile."

carla_prodeng: meanwhile I can push a config patch to proxy to disable the header duplication: change `preserve_keepalive_headers: false`. Preparing canary.

dan_oncall: starting canary patch on proxy-2: `kubectl apply -f proxy-patch.yaml`

incident-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for manifest proxy-patch.yaml on cluster prod-edge (canary=proxy-2)

alice_sre: monitoring token-aggregator for drop in duplicate rate after canary. If stable for 3 minutes, we promote.

oncall_ml: also kicking off quick reconciliation job to estimate true token counts for last 30m using KV cache and raw ingests: `python tools/reconcile_tokens.py --window 30m --mode conservative`

evelyn_data: job started: jid=rec-2310456830. Will attach results here when done.

dan_oncall: canary logs look good so far. No duplicate header entries on proxy-2. Promoting to rest of proxy set.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: rollout complete: proxy-patch applied to 5/5 pods (prod-edge).

evelyn_data: reconciliation done. Summary:
- reported_tokens_window = 1,204,820
- dedup_estimate = 1,204,820 - 0.062 * reported = 1,132,646 (approx)
- conservative_correction = -72,174 tokens (~0.06%)

ben_billing: thanks. With billing.overage_protect still true, we're safe. We'll run backfill to write corrected counts and expire temporary flags before final invoice run.

frank_support: updated customers: "We've applied protective measures and will reconcile your usage. No customer will be billed for duplicated tokens."

carla_prodeng: root cause: proxy keepalive bug introduced by http2 multiplexing change in 2026-03-15 08:40 UTC. Patch reverts the header coalescing logic. We'll schedule full postmortem.

alice_sre: action items:
1) ben_billing to coordinate backfill and confirm final counts (due +2h)
2) evelyn_data to publish reconciliation report and upload diff CSV to S3 (due +30m)
3) carla_prodeng to open PR with permanent fix + e2e test (due +4h)
4) dan_oncall to run end-to-end smoke and verify no regressions (due +1h)
5) frank_support to continue customer comms + triage incoming tickets

ben_billing: started backfill job: jid=backfill-2310456870. Will verify dry-run then commit.

evelyn_data: reconciliation report uploaded: s3://redwood-incidents/reports/2310456789-recon.csv (contains per-customer diffs).

ben_billing: dry-run shows expected adjustments, committing now. Billing flags will remain suppressed until we finish sanity checks (target 30m).

dan_oncall: smoke ok. No new duplicates seen in 15m of sampling.

alice_sre: marking incident as mitigated for paging reasons. We still have action items and a postmortem to write; I'll create an incident ticket.

incident-bot: Incident MTR-9982 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Pager resolved.

frank_support: closing customer-facing loop: send final note in 1h after backfill verification.

carla_prodeng: posting tentative postmortem in #postmortems and will link to this thread.

ben_billing: final note: total token delta corrected = -72,174; estimated affected customers = 14 (all notified). No bill finalizations changed due to safety flag.

alice_sre: thanks everyone. Good coordination. Will archive logs and start postmortem doc.

frank_support: :thumbsup:

oncall_ml: adding root cause tag to incident: `root_cause: proxy-http2-multiplex-dup`

alice_sre: last check-in: all systems nominal. I'll set `billing.overage_protect=false` only after ben confirms invoices safe.

ben_billing: setting flag false at 2310456890 after final verification. `PUT /admin/flags/billing.overage_protect false` -> 202 Accepted.

incident-bot: Incident MTR-9982 closed.
